## About
The Brown Paint Company is Kelly Brown and his crew, painting homes and businesses across Austin and Central Texas from our office on Research Blvd.
Clients tell us they like the straight lines, the daily cleanup, and knowing Kelly will make sure the job is done right. One reviewer has had us paint the inside and outside of their house, and another found us because a neighbor recommended us.
We hold a 4.4 rating from 21 Google reviews. If you have a room, a whole interior, or an exterior that needs work, give us a call.

## Services
- Interior painting: Single rooms or the entire interior, with prep and cleanup each day.
- Exterior painting: Full exterior repaints with attention to detail and respect for your neighbors.
- Residential and commercial painting: We paint homes and commercial spaces in Austin and Central Texas.

## FAQ
Q: What area do you serve?
A: We paint homes and businesses in Austin and Central Texas.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Q: Will the crew clean up?
A: Yes. Two reviewers mention that the crew handled prep and cleaned up every day of the job.
